sentence: This project builds neural networks that use optimization principles to make their outputs follow physical laws and other strict constraints.
This project works where biotechnology and materials science meet, with examples such as materials for wound healing and how tumors respond to chemotherapy.
This project uses deep neural networks to make computer simulations of deformable objects less costly to run.
This project develops ways to manage water for agriculture, using artificial intelligence tools to help people make water use decisions.
This project builds methods that help large deep learning models work well with limited labeled data and shrink the models.
This project builds a system that helps drones find their position and fly safely using sensors and cameras when the global positioning system is spoofed.
This project studies attacks and defenses for devices that combine the Internet of Things and artificial intelligence, to protect data and privacy.
This project works on air and water problems in coastal communities, including floods, water quality and air quality.
This project studies how diatoms in an ice-covered lake cope with darkness and little oxygen, using genomic data from microbial mats.
This project studies why computing problems on geometric data get much harder as the dimension increases and looks for efficient algorithms.
This project develops course content and a stackable credential program for technology support and cybersecurity work.
This project builds open-source tools for managing digital identities, access controls and credentials on distributed systems.
This project builds reinforcement learning methods that keep systems in areas like robotics and autonomous driving away from unsafe states.
This project builds artificial intelligence that turns health data from wearable sensors into what-if guidance about changes that may improve health.
This project tries to measure the lifetime of the Higgs boson, using machine learning on data from a particle physics experiment.
